commands: git fetch origin agent/nvs-persistence-hardening && git checkout -B agent/nvs-persistence-hardening origin/agent/nvs-persistence-hardening && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo BRANCH_CLEAN

rm -rf build/idf sdkconfig sdkconfig.old && make build > /tmp/growbox-psram-build.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /tmp/growbox-psram-build.log; test $rc -eq 0; ! grep -q 'Choice SPIRAM_USE has multiple active selections' /tmp/growbox-psram-build.log; echo PSRAM_CHOICE_WARNING_GONE
grep -E '^CONFIG_SPIRAM_USE_' sdkconfig || true; grep -q '^CONFIG_SPIRAM_USE_CAPS_ALLOC=y$' sdkconfig && ! grep -q '^CONFIG_SPIRAM_USE_MALLOC=y$' sdkconfig && echo PSRAM_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_PASS
